decisions.reason: ACE3 was publicly launched as a new industry standard for the firm's core airfield lighting control business, so heavy investment and public commitment strongly favor keeping it.
The air situation display had its own page and supports the firm's tower and surveillance integration strategy, so it remains justified as part of the integrated offering.
The training program is a low-cost service tied to the installed base, and any weak results can be blamed on pandemic travel limits, which are temporary.
The AGL training course complements the core lighting business, and its disappointing demand can plausibly be attributed to pandemic disruption, so it is kept.
Collaboration software is central to the announced direction of integrated, collaborative decision-making operations, which strongly favors persisting with it.
The MLAT system was publicly announced at inter airport Europe as highly advanced and fits the surveillance strategy, so public commitment and sunk R&D favor keeping it.
